verdict.rationale: First-party docs show workflow authoring in TypeScript (a dedicated develop guide and testing suite) and in Python (OpenAI Agents integration, cookbook recipes), and a user describes Temporal as cross-language. Nothing in the pack documents a Go SDK or demonstrates feature parity across SDKs. missing for 10: Go SDK and other-language SDK documentation, evidence of feature parity across SDKs, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-language authoring.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I author workflows in the language my team already uses — TypeScript, Python, Go, or more — with real feature parity across SDKs

citations.quote: a short walkthrough of how to use the Temporal primitives (Activities, Workflows, and Workers) to build and run a Temporal application
Temporal's integration with the OpenAI Agents SDK for Python lets you run agents as Temporal Workflows.
Build a durable agentic loop in Python with Claude tool calling and Temporal.
It's a full scheduling of work and queues that's cross-machine, cross-language, and very transparent.
